facts.label: Passado e past progressive
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação em andamento e o passado simples para a ação curta: I was planting flowers when it started to rain.

facts.label: Ação longa
facts.sub: Para uma ação em andamento no passado, use was/were + -ing: I was planting flowers. Use was com I, he, she e it, e were com you, we e they.

facts.label: Ação curta
facts.sub: Para a ação que interrompe, use o passado simples: It started to rain. Alguns verbos são irregulares: run vira ran, fly vira flew, come vira came.

items.why: We say I was planting flowers.

items.s: When can start the short action.

group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

answers: We use was + -ing for an action in progress. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I was plant flowers”. → Falso (We say I was planting flowers.)
When can start the short action. → Verdadeiro (Yes: when it started to rain.)

pages.title: A green garden · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cool morning in a green garden in Dublin. Small drops of rain shine on the leaves. Eva stands next to a row of tomatoes. Her friend Nora looks over the fence. Nora likes the bright flowers. She asks about yesterday.
“Hi, Eva! Your garden looks great!” says Nora. “Thanks, Nora! I was planting flowers when it started to rain yesterday.” says Eva. “Oh no! What did you do?” says Nora.
